module_summary: The cover-art pipeline of the menu ELF: artqueue.cpp is an interrupt-bracketed intrusive FIFO of load requests, artworker.cpp/h hold the art worker thread's state (epochs, focus tracking, HUD counters), and artload.cpp runs the dedicated art thread (priority 72), its cancellation/teardown API (cacheCancelPendingImageLoadsTimed, cacheAbortMmceImageLoadsTimed, cacheShutdownArtLoads, cacheEnd), the .tar art-pack lookup and the staged PNG load. artindex.cpp keeps an in-RAM listing of up to three art directories so a missing cover is answered without a FAT directory walk. atlas.cpp is the guillotine glyph atlas used by fntsys.cpp; coverflow.cpp draws the coverflow carousel element with its slide animation and lookahead warming; fntsys.h is the font API. All files are compiled into the main riptopl ELF (ps2.yaml:641, with -ffunction-sections and --gc-sections).

reusable_helpers.name: ArtIndex::hashName
reusable_helpers.what: FNV-1a hash over an upper-cased, optionally length-limited name

reusable_helpers.name: ArtIndex::splitPath
reusable_helpers.what: splits a PS2 path into directory and basename, handling the colon-only form mass0:x.png

reusable_helpers.name: ArtIndex::pictureExt
reusable_helpers.what: offset of a .png/.jpg/.jpeg extension in any letter case, -1 otherwise

reusable_helpers.name: ArtQueue
reusable_helpers.what: intrusive doubly linked FIFO guarded by DIntr/EIntr with O(1) promote and detach-all

reusable_helpers.name: Atlas::place
reusable_helpers.what: guillotine rectangle packer that copies a bitmap into a GS texture atlas

reusable_helpers.name: fntWrapText
reusable_helpers.what: greedy word wrap of UTF-8 text to a pixel width (CJK/Thai aware)

reusable_helpers.name: fntRenderStringFit
reusable_helpers.what: draws a string limited to a width, scrolling or ending in an ellipsis

findings.title: cacheAbortMmceImageLoadsTimed called right before cacheCancelPendingImageLoadsTimed at six sites is redundant and can lengthen the drain
findings.problem: Cancel is a strict superset of Abort: it flags the in-flight request whatever its bus, frees the whole queue, and waits for queued==0 && active==0. Abort first frees only SIO2 requests, RE-PUSHES the rest and wakes the worker, then waits for an SIO2 read; once it sleeps the worker can pop a re-pushed non-SIO2 request and start a new device read that the following Cancel must then wait out. The pair costs up to 2x the timeout instead of 1x.
findings.fix: At the six paired sites delete the cacheAbortMmceImageLoadsTimed call and keep only cacheCancelPendingImageLoadsTimed (fold guiwait's abortOk into cancelOk). Keep Abort where it is used alone (mmcesupport, bdmlaunch, bdmsupport, menusys, themes.cpp:1415).
findings.benefit: ~8 call-site lines removed; worst-case drain halved (500-2000 ms less when an SIO2 read is in flight); one detach/re-push pass and a possible extra device read avoided (INFERRED from the code paths)
findings.evidence: Read artload.cpp:428-508 (both functions). Grep cacheAbortMmceImageLoadsTimed|cacheCancelPendingImageLoads over src: paired calls at lwnbdctl.cpp:141-142, guiwait.cpp:67-68, themes.cpp:1820-1821, appsupport.cpp:789-790, hddsupport.cpp:2178-2179 and 2267-2268 (all read); Abort alone at mmcesupport.cpp:1204,1257,1326,1851, bdmlaunch.cpp:104,198, bdmsupport.cpp:2404, menusys.cpp:920, themes.cpp:1415. Worker priority 72 (artload.cpp:31) is below the GUI (31), so it runs when the caller sleeps in Abort's DelayThread loop (artload.cpp:499-505).

findings.title: ArtWorker::refused is never written; the HUD's R counter is dead and five one-field debug getters feed one HUD line
findings.problem: gArtW.refused has no writer anywhere (only read at artload.cpp:181), so cacheDebugCounters always returns 0 for it; drawArtHud receives it in r and never prints it (format at guioverlay.cpp:211 has no R), while its comment still explains R. The remaining HUD values are fetched through five separate getters (cacheDebugTransientFail, KeyTooLong, Counters, Dropped, LastLoad) whose only caller is drawArtHud.
findings.fix: Delete the refused field, the refused out-parameter of cacheDebugCounters and the R text in the HUD comment. Optionally merge the five getters into one that fills all counters (or let guioverlay read gArtW/gArtQ directly).
findings.benefit: ~10 lines for the dead field/param, ~15 more if the getters merge; a few dozen bytes of .text and 4 bytes of .data (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep 'refused' over all .c/.cpp/.h: artworker.h:52 (definition), artload.cpp:174,180-181 (read), texcache.h:191 (prototype), guioverlay.cpp:143,147 (r declared/filled); no increment anywhere. guioverlay.cpp:211-216 format string prints q, a, d, X but not r. Grep of the five getters: only guioverlay.cpp:147-148,212-213 call them.

findings.title: Stale, orphaned and repeated comments in the art pipeline after the texcache split and the move off the ioman worker
findings.problem: Comments describe code that is gone: artload 38-39 is an orphan copy of artworker.h:15-16; 58-75 says cacheLoadImage is an ioman handler at priority 30 (it runs on the art thread at 72, lines 31 and 510); 150-162 describe counters that now live in ArtQueue; 445 says priority 64; 457-459 says five call sites and MMCE (14 sites, SIO2); 528-541 cite texcache.c line numbers and ioPutRequest; 680 says the flag is read by nobody (read at 688); artworker.h cites texcache.cpp, gui.c, gArtRefused/gArtDone, the IO worker and the shared ioman queue (77-88, contradicted by artload.cpp:817-822); artqueue.h:60 points to src/artqueue.cpp for a rationale that sits in artload.cpp:330-349; the MX4SIO note is repeated at artqueue.h:34-38 and artqueue.cpp:80-84.
findings.fix: Delete the orphan blocks (artload 38-39, 150-162), move the ART QUEUE rationale (artload 330-349) to artqueue.cpp and drop the repeated copy in artqueue.h, and rewrite the false sentences to one line each (or delete them).
findings.benefit: ~60 comment lines removed; no binary change (READ: comments only)
findings.evidence: Read every cited range. ART_THREAD_PRIORITY = 72 at artload.cpp:31; cacheInit comment artload.cpp:817-822 says no ioRegisterHandler; shutdownAbandoned read at artload.cpp:688; ArtQueue implementation is src/gfx/artqueue.cpp (no rationale comment there beyond 43-46/74-87); grep cacheAbortMmceImageLoadsTimed gives 14 call sites; files are .cpp now (texcache.cpp, textures.cpp, gui.cpp, themes.cpp).

findings.title: Include blocks copied on file splits keep headers the file no longer uses (artload.cpp, texcache.cpp, coverflow.cpp)
findings.problem: artload.cpp:2-21 and texcache.cpp:3-22 are the same include list. In artload.cpp bdmsupport.h, appsupport.h, favsupport.h and hddsupport.h are unused: the symbols their own comments name (bdmModeIsSIO2, appGetArtMode, favGetArtMode, hddGetArtArchivePath) are used only in texcache.cpp:154-205. In texcache.cpp tar.h, pad.h and sound.h are unused. coverflow.cpp copied themes.cpp's list and uses nothing from fntsys.h, lang.h, pad.h, sound.h, favsupport.h, vcdsupport.h, libview.h or rabadge.h.
findings.fix: Delete the unused #include lines (and their stale 'used for X' comments).
findings.benefit: ~15 lines; no ELF change, slightly faster compiles and clearer dependencies (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep in artload.cpp for bdm*/app*/fav*/hdd* identifiers: only the include lines 16-19. Grep in texcache.cpp for getKeyPressed|bgm|TAR_|Tar|KEY_: only include comments (gEnableArtTar comes from opl.h:324). Grep in coverflow.cpp for fnt*( _l( vcdDisplayName libViewActive raBadge fav*( pad*( sfx bgm: only include lines 17,18,20. INFERRED part: that no header relies on one of these for a transitive type; a compile confirms it.

findings.title: Checks for states that cannot occur in cacheLoadImage, the timed drains, Atlas::create, ArtIndex and drawCoverFlow
findings.problem: cacheLoadImage tests !req, !entry, !cache and !list, but its only caller skips NULL (artload.cpp:788) and the only enqueue (texcache.cpp:440-447) fills them from values already checked non-NULL (texcache.cpp:229, 422). The negative-waitTicks 'wait forever' branch has no caller (all pass 0, 500 or 2000). Placement new on non-NULL memory cannot yield NULL (atlas.cpp:73). slotFor/build never return NULL (artindex.cpp:149-301). coverflow's leavingIndex bounds test is implied by i == leavingIndex with i already in range. cacheEnd re-derives the ms value it computed at line 877.
findings.fix: Delete these checks; make the two wait loops plain counted loops; log the saved budget value in cacheEnd.
findings.benefit: ~15 lines; a few instructions per art load (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read texcache.cpp:226-229 (NULL cache/list rejected), 422-470 (sole malloc of load_image_request_t). Wait constants: lwnbdctl.cpp:77 = 500, hddsupport.cpp:312 = 2000, mmcesupport.cpp:95 = 500, themes.cpp:1178 = 500, literals 0 and 500 elsewhere. artindex.cpp:147-301 build() always returns &slots_[next_]. coverflow.cpp:276-277 i comes from drawOrder entries bounded by drawFirst/drawLast <= coverTotal.

findings.title: Small duplications inside artindex.cpp: picCmp equals hashCmp, repeated free triples, repeated reject preamble
findings.problem: picCmp and hashCmp are the same unsigned compare (Pic.hash is Pic's first member, so hashCmp already works on a Pic array). The readError and overflowed exits both free the same three buffers and return. mayExist and findPicture repeat the backslash/smb/udpfs reject, the owner-thread check and splitPath.
findings.fix: Delete picCmp and sort pics with hashCmp; merge the two failure exits; move the shared reject/owner/split preamble into one private helper that both call.
findings.evidence: Read artindex.cpp in full and include/artindexint.h:40-44 (Pic { unsigned int hash; int name; }).

findings.title: ArtIndex: single-instance class in a private header behind five C forwarders, with its docs repeated in two headers
findings.problem: gArtIndex is the only ArtIndex; artindexint.h is included only by artindex.cpp (and named by a source-text test), and the five artIndex* functions only forward to it. The API is documented twice (artindex.h and artindexint.h:12-23).
findings.fix: Keep the C API in artindex.h and make the state file-static in artindex.cpp (functions operate on it directly); delete artindexint.h and the forwarders, and update .github/scripts/test_ripps2_art_port.py:37.
findings.benefit: ~45 lines (98-line header and 24 lines of forwarders become ~75 lines of file-static state); no ELF change expected (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep artindexint|gArtIndex over the repo: artindex.cpp:18,23-47, artindexint.h:7,95, .github/scripts/test_ripps2_art_port.py:37, docs/CPP-CONVERSION-PLAN.md:484 (the class was a deliberate conversion step). Callers use only the C functions: textures.cpp:1345,1357,1431, guioverlay.cpp:195, opl.cpp:1008, settingsio.cpp:2482, udpfssupport.cpp:571, artload.cpp:777.

findings.title: Atlas supports five pixel formats but the only shipped caller uses GS_PSM_T8
findings.problem: Atlas::create takes a psm and copyData switches over CT32/CT24/CT16/CT16S/T8 through pixelSize, but the single product caller is fntsys.cpp:534 with GS_PSM_T8; the CT32 path is exercised only by tests/host/test_atlas.cpp:66.
findings.fix: Drop the psm parameter and pixelSize, fix the atlas at GS_PSM_T8 with 1 byte per pixel, and remove the CT32 case from the host test.
findings.benefit: ~20 lines; a small switch and branch out of glyph placement (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep Atlas::create over the repo: atlas.cpp:67 (definition), fntsys.cpp:534 (GS_PSM_T8), tests/host/test_atlas.cpp:20 (T8) and :66 (CT32), .github/scripts/test_font_flush_frame_lock.py:147 (stub). The ~Atlas lead is wrong: it runs through raii::DestroyFree (raii.h:89).

findings.title: focusHashValue re-implements the FNV-1a loop that ArtIndex::hashName already has
findings.problem: artworker.cpp:13-22 is the same FNV-1a loop (same basis and prime) as ArtIndex::hashName, minus the case folding; the focus hash only detects a selection change, so case folding would not matter (artworker.h:89-93: a collision only keeps some obsolete prefetch).
findings.fix: Expose the existing hash (for example as a free function next to the artIndex* API) and call it from ArtWorker::updateFocus; delete focusHashValue.
findings.evidence: Grep 2166136261 over .c/.cpp/.h: artindex.cpp:56, artworker.cpp:15, hddsupport.cpp:148 (a different skip-character key, not included). focusHashValue's only caller is artworker.cpp:27.
